purpose: Check that the work router selects one focused skill instead of becoming a broad framework.
positivePrompts: Use route-work to decide what skill should handle this.
I do not know whether this needs scoping, options, spec, tickets, or review.
negativePrompts: Directly use review-code on this diff.
Run the research-brief skill for this vendor comparison.

cases.prompt: Only tell us which skill should handle this vague product architecture change and what the next step is.
checks: Explains why that skill is the right next step.
Uses the daily flow order without running every phase.
Stops at a handoff because the prompt explicitly asks only for routing.

cases.prompt: Choose the right skill for this release-safety question and complete that workflow instead of only telling me what to use.
checks: Names one selected skill and a concise reason.
Continues into the selected skill's workflow in the same response.
Returns the selected skill's downstream work product.

traceExpectations: The output clearly identifies the route and reason before any downstream result.
The output stops at a handoff only for routing-only requests or missing user-owned decisions.
Only one focused skill is selected.
